article.title: Philadelphia takes road win streak into matchup with Houston
article.linkText: Philadelphia takes road win streak into matchup with Houston
article.story: Philadelphia 76ers (16-4, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Houston Rockets (14-5, fourth in the Western Conference) Houston; Saturday, 8:30 p.m. EST LINE: Rockets -12.5; over/under is 221.5 BOTTOM LINE: Philadelphia hits the road against Houston looking to continue its four-game road winning streak. The Rockets are 9-1 on their home court. Houston ranks fourth in the Western Conference in team defense, giving up just 109.9 points while holding opponents to 46.1% shooting. The 76ers are 8-1 on the road. Philadelphia ranks sixth in the Eastern Conference allowing only 111.7 points while holding opponents to 46.1% shooting. The 118.0 points per game the Rockets score are 6.3 more points than the 76ers allow (111.7). The 76ers score 5.0 more points per game (114.9) than the Rockets give up (109.9). TOP PERFORMERS: Alperen Sengun is averaging 22 points, 9.3 rebounds and 7.2 assists for the Rockets. Kevin Durant is averaging 22.2 points over the last 10 games. Tyrese Maxey is averaging 25.3 points and 5.7 assists for the 76ers. LeBron James is averaging 16.0 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Rockets: 7-3, averaging 118.1 points, 47.3 rebounds, 28.6 assists, 5.5 steals and 5.3 blocks per game while shooting 48.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.0 points per game. 76ers: 8-2, averaging 120.3 points, 42.3 rebounds, 28.2 assists, 7.1 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 49.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 116.7 points. INJURIES: Rockets: Steven Adams: day to day (knee). 76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), Jaylen Brown: out (hamstring), Dean Wade: out (injury management). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
